title: FAIRe (FAIR eDNA) metadata checklist
description:
FAIRe (FAIR eDNA) is a metadata checklist and data templates that make environmental DNA (eDNA), metabarcoding and targeted-assay data Findable, Accessible, Interoperable and Reusable.

This is version 1.0.2 of the checklist, first released on GitHub on 2025-07-02. It contains the checklist (FAIRe_checklist_v1.0.2.xlsx) and the full data template (FAIRe_checklist_v1.0.2_FULLtemplate.xlsx). previous_versions/ holds v1.0, published as supplementary material to Takahashi et al. (2025), and v1.0.1. CHANGELOG.md lists the changes since v1.0. The checklist files are unchanged since 2025-07-02; for archiving, the README was rewritten and LICENSE and this metadata were added.

Guidelines and documentation: https://fair-edna.github.io.
